title: Incremental TPS shadow testing framework for core model fleet
creator: Daniel Park
description: Build a repeatable, low-cost shadow testing framework to measure tokens-per-second (TPS) and p95 latency for the core model fleet under incremental load profiles. This harness (codename: shadow-runner) will run parallel to production traffic (shadow mode) and exercise model variants with realistic request shapes, sequence lengths, and KV-cache priming. Goals: 1) detect regressions in TPS and tail latency before rollouts; 2) quantify per-model throughput under different batching and sequence-length distributions; 3) provide automated regression tickets with diffs against baseline and a confidence score.
acceptance_criteria: Shadow-runner can replay 5 canonical workloads (short chat, long form, summarization, instruction, embeddings) with configurable concurrency and request mix
Stable metrics pipeline capturing TPS, p95, p99, error-rate, batch-size distribution, and KV cache hit-rate into Grafana/Prometheus
Regression detector flags >3% sustained TPS drop or >20% p95 increase compared to baseline and automatically files ENG ticket with sample traces
Can run scheduled nightly sweep and on-demand smoke runs; results stored and versioned per-model and per-code commit
Integrations: GitHub PR link back to failing run, Opsgenie alerting, and Confluence report template populated
tasks: Design workload profiles and corpus (owner: Aisha) - include sequence length histograms and prompt families
Implement shadow-runner worker that can route live HTTP payloads to model replicas in shadow mode (owner: Lewis)
KV-cache priming utility to seed common prefixes and measure cache-hit effect (owner: Priya)
Metrics exporter for TPS and latency percentiles with tags: model, variant, region, batch_size (owner: Marco)
Regression detector service: sliding-window comparison, anomaly scoring, and automated ticketing (owner: Aisha)
Grafana dashboards and alert rules (owner: SRE team)
End-to-end test harness and CI job for nightly sweeps (owner: CI infra)
Document runbook + Confluence page and run templates (owner: PM)
